title: Video by drcintas
description:
This Chinese AI just did something even Photoshop struggles with, and it’s completely free.

You upload a normal photo, click Decompose, and in seconds it splits the image into separate editable layers.

The background, objects, and different elements all get separated cleanly, almost like the image was originally designed inside Photoshop.

Which means you can edit each part individually.

And the best part?

It’s open source and completely free to try.

🔥 Comment “IMAGE” and I’ll send you the link.
